newsitem.title: USA: PP&L shuts down Susquehanna Unit 1.
newsitem.headline: PP&L shuts down Susquehanna Unit 1.

text.p: PP&L Resources Inc said the Unit 1 reactor at the Susquehanna nuclear power plant near Berwick, Pa., was shut down on Monday to repair a small leak in a pipe inside the reactor building.
"We expect to have the unit back on line in about a week," the company said. Unit 2 at the plant continues to operate at full power, it noted.

The leak was found during inspections that are made as the unit slowly increases power after a refueling outage, the utility said. The 1,090 megawatt unit was restarted Wednesday following a 47-day refueling outage.
Earlier on Monday, a spokesman told Reuters that Unit 1 might be closed to replace a steam drain pipeline.
The utility said, "it's a leak about the size of a pinhole in a 4-inch pipe that provides drainage for certain plant systems."
